title: Zariski degree-zero comparison for a proper scheme over a henselian pair
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $Z=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$, viewed as a closed subset of the underlying topological space of $X$ (the projection $Z\to X$ is a closed immersion, the base change of $\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)\to\operatorname{Spec}A$). For every sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on the underlying topological space of $X$, the restriction map $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(Z,\mathcal F|_Z)$ is bijective, where $\mathcal F|_Z$ is the topological inverse image of $\mathcal F$ along the inclusion $Z\subseteq X$ (the sheafification of $U\mapsto\varinjlim_{V\supseteq U}\mathcal F(V)$, $V$ open in $X$).

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 59.91.1, Tag 0A0B (label lemma-zariski-h0-proper-over-henselian-pair, line 18167); its proof uses Tag 09ZG (lemma-h0-topological), Tag 094L, Tag 03H2 (Stein factorization, general), Tag 09XK (integral over henselian pair), Tag 09Y6 (irreducible henselian pair connected), Tag 0377
